prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone far-background environment layer for a modular 2D mobile game map, landscape 2:1 panorama. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not a screen to copy. Paint a richly detailed volcanic fantasy coliseum at the same polished hand-painted mobile-game quality: huge curved blue-grey stone arena walls, tiered arches and battlements, tiny silhouetted spectators, hanging red torn banners, heavy chains, orange braziers, and a horned carved stone lava spout with glowing eyes slightly right of centre. Cold luminous blue sky and distant architecture, saturated orange lava reflecting up onto weathered stone. Strong atmospheric perspective, bevelled irregular masonry, fine painted material texture and soft bounced light, charming chunky cartoon forms with bold confident edges, NOT flat vector art or low-poly geometry. Composition: far architecture occupies upper 65%; lower 35% is a continuous lava chasm with a few distant crags, kept visually calm and open so independent floating level platforms can later be overlaid. Continuous terrain reaches both left and right edges at the same height; suitable for horizontal scrolling. CRITICAL: NO UI, no buttons, no resource bars, no numbers, no lettering, no question marks, no stars, no chests, NO foreground level platforms or floating islands, no foreground fence or close-up spikes. This is only the rear scenery layer, not a complete game screen. Full bleed opaque background, no borders, no watermark.
prompts.node: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated reusable level-node pedestal sprite for a premium hand-painted 2D mobile game, on true transparent background. Image 1 is style/reference only: match its chunky, richly painted volcanic-fortress game art, material texture, warm orange lava bounce-light and cold blue rim light. Create a single complete compact vertical assembly, front view with a slight top-down three-quarter perspective: at the bottom a floating jagged blue-grey volcanic rock island tapering down with a small torn red banner hanging on its front, on top a circular beige cracked stone plinth, standing on the plinth a thick square/octagonal weathered silver riveted boss portrait frame with an EMPTY very dark charcoal inset, above the frame a BLANK warm brown wooden number plaque made of two or three planks with metal corner bolts, and above the plaque ONE shiny chunky golden five-point star. Very polished illustrated game asset with organic irregular silhouettes, hand-painted stone fissures, wood grain, bevelled aged steel with specular highlights, soft ambient shadow, strong depth. No numbers, NO question mark, no lettering or symbols on the plaque or portrait inset; those are live UI text added by the game. NO chest, no surrounding landscape, no other UI, no lava pool, no duplicate pedestals. Single sprite fully visible and uncropped with 6% clear transparent padding on all sides. Composition: centered vertical assembly fills most of a roughly 3:4 canvas; the stone island occupies the lower 35%, metal portrait frame the middle 27%, wooden plaque above it, star at top. Frame front inner square must be clear and large for a question-mark Label later. Transparent background must be real alpha, no checkerboard painted into it, no white matte, no watermark.

prompts.foreground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE panoramic foreground parallax overlay for a 2D volcanic coliseum game. Image 1 is a style reference only. Paint an independently usable strip of close-up foreground fortress silhouettes along the BOTTOM EDGE: richly hand-painted dark charcoal-blue jagged stone parapets and irregular iron spikes, two partially visible torn dark red banners, a small warm orange torch near one side. Warm lava rim-light under crags, subtle cold blue edge highlights, confident chunky outlined cartoon forms and painterly texture, same high art quality as reference. Landscape canvas approximately 2:1. IMPORTANT composition: TOP 65% of the canvas completely empty transparent alpha, all forms grow upward from below the bottom edge, mostly in bottom 25%, a few spikes/banner tips can reach bottom 35%, never cover the centre or sky where interactive level nodes will sit. Continuous low dark stone base reaches left and right canvas edges at matching heights, without side end-caps, so strip can repeat horizontally; avoid tall unique objects at seams. Bottom cropped naturally as a foreground overlay, no sky, no lava pool, no background arena, NO level platforms, no chests, no stars, no letters, no UI. Genuine transparent background, no painted checkerboard, no black/white matte, no watermark.
prompts.ui_atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production UI sprite ATLAS on a genuine transparent background, square image, exactly NINE isolated game graphics arranged in a perfectly regular 3 columns by 3 rows grid. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Premium hand-painted cartoon fantasy mobile-game interface, chunky bevelled edges, material texture and very polished highlights, orange lava rim-light and cool-blue small rim highlights. Every icon entirely inside its cell with generous transparent spacing, no objects crossing cell boundaries. NO letters, no words, no digits, no watermarks, no grid lines, no labels. Top row, left to right: (1) chunky green rectangular Home button with a white house symbol; (2) wide red wooden-and-gold spiked shop sign with rivets and a small gold shopping cart at left, wide EMPTY centre/right for a live label; (3) long dark navy recessed resource counter bar with dark metal/gold rim, EMPTY middle for a live number. Middle row left to right: (4) large orange left arrow button with double silver outline; (5) large orange double-left arrow button with double silver outline; (6) wide empty dark blue/metal bevelled navigation plaque with bronze corner rivets for a live label. Bottom row left to right: (7) bold glossy golden lightning bolt energy icon; (8) thick shiny gold coin with an embossed crown; (9) beautiful faceted cyan blue diamond. Treat each cell as a separate sprite, maintain equal cell centres at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 of width and height. All text areas truly empty. Actual transparent alpha background, no white matte, no painted checkerboard.
